 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur

1. Heard learned counsel for the parties at Bar and perused the material available on record.
2.

This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.08/2025 registered at Police Station Khedapa, Jodhpur Rural,
for offences under Section 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
3. This Court looking to the nature of allegation against the present petitioner, vide order dated 03.03.2025 directed the learned Public Prosecutor to call for the case diary.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor in compliance of this Court's order dated 03.03.2025 has produced the case diary.

5. Upon perusal of the case diary, this Court prima facie finds that FIR has been lodged by the victim 'B' after about three years from the date when she was subjected to sexual assault/rape by the petitioner for the first time.

In the FIR, it has been alleged [2025:RJ-JD:13947] (2 of 2)
Dura Ram @ Durga Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:13947) on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10476862/
1 [CRLMB-2471/2025] that the victim 'B' was subjected to sexual assault by the petitioner from the last three years on the pretext of making her obscene video and photographs viral.

entities.text: Dura Ram @ Durga Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:13947)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, no obscene video or photographs as alleged have been recovered by the investigating agency.

This Court further prima facie does not find any plausible explanation having been furnished by the prosecution for lodging the FIR after a delay of more than three years from the date of alleged incident and the petitioner does not have any criminal antecedents.

This Court also prima facie finds that the prosecution has not shown any apprehension of the petitioner tampering with the evidence or involving himself in cases of similar nature in case he is enlarged on bail.
6. In view of the above, this Court, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

7. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Dura Ram @ Durga Ram S/o Amrit Lal shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.08/2025 registered at Police Station Khedapa, Jodhpur Rural, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.

(KULDEEP MATHUR), J 145-Dinesh/-
